cases.case_label: SVA in NR5A1 intron 4 (46,XY DSD family)
cases.mechanism_detail: A rare SVA in NR5A1 intron 4 found by PacBio HiFi segregated with 46,XY DSD in a multi-generational family and was associated with loss of expression of the allele in cis.
cases.quote: The insertion segregated among affected family members and was associated with loss-of-expression of alleles in cis, demonstrating a functional impact on NR5A1.
